context_facts.text: Food transport ('food-miles') accounts for about 19% (nearly a fifth) of global food-system emissions, about 3.0 GtCO2e a year; fruit and vegetable freight is about 36% of food-miles emissions (Li et al. 2022, Nature Food, doi:10.1038/s43016-022-00531-w).

sources.title: Global food-miles account for nearly 20% of total food-systems emissions
sources.quote: indicating that transport accounts for about 19% of total food-system emissions (stemming from transport, production and land-use change)

sources.title: Fifth of global food-related emissions due to transport
sources.quote: They have found that 19 percent of global food system greenhouse gas emissions are caused by transportation.

sources.title: Global food-miles account for nearly 20% of total food-systems emissions
sources.quote: Global freight transport associated with vegetable and fruit consumption contributes 36% of food-miles emissions

context_facts.text: For the average US household, food production dominates food-related emissions (83%); transport as a whole is about 11% of life-cycle emissions and final delivery from producer to retail only 4% (Weber & Matthews 2008, Environ. Sci. Technol., doi:10.1021/es702969f).

sources.title: Food-miles and the relative climate impacts of food choices in the United States (abstract via Europe PMC, PMID 18546681)
sources.quote: Transportation as a whole represents only 11% of life-cycle GHG emissions, and final delivery from producer to retail contributes only 4%.

apple.min_pot_note: RHS: dwarfing rootstocks (M9, M26) are best for pots (no pot size given)
apple.sow_months_basis: RHS month-by-month planting calendar (crop is planted, not sown)
tips: Choose the rootstock for your space: dwarfing (M9/M26) for pots and small gardens.
Plant in full sun in a sheltered site not prone to late frosts that damage blossom.

lemon.days_basis: perennial tree – fruit ripens over many months; grown in pots outside the tropics

lemon.sow_months_basis: RHS month-by-month planting calendar (crop is planted, not sown)
tips: Not frost hardy: overwinter indoors in a bright, cool spot and move outside in summer (UK/IE).
Water well in the growing season and thin young fruits – a 1m tree should carry no more than ~20.

_notes.water_and_difficulty: water (low/med/high) and difficulty are editorial judgements from the cited source text, not values stated by the sources.
_notes.days_to_harvest: Mostly NC State Extension Table 1 (US-South climate) cross-checked with RHS; null for perennial fruit/herbs where a days figure is not meaningful – see days_basis.
_notes.sow_months: sow_months_north from the RHS month-by-month calendar (UK/Ireland). sow_months_south is a simple +6 month shift for Australia, not a sourced calendar.
_notes.min_pot_l: Only filled where a source gives volume (NC State US gallons/quarts converted to litres); otherwise null with RHS diameter in min_pot_note.
_notes.height_cm: Range covers the cultivar spread in the sources; trees/fruit trees given in cm too (apple depends on rootstock).
